issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to call setup_env() with no parameters, but the solution implementation calls setup_env with one argument (push 1 / call setup_env) and adjusts the stack. The template does not declare or call setup_env at all. This discrepancy creates confusion about whether students must call setup_env and whether it takes parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent: either (A) update the solution to call setup_env with no parameters (remove the push 1 and corresponding add esp,4) and ensure the template includes extern setup_env (and optionally a TODO to call it), or (B) change the problem statement to state that setup_env should be called with one integer parameter. Prefer option A to match the documented instruction (no parameters).
